sources.title: Kimi K3: 2.8T Open Model for Coding & Knowledge Work
sources.snippet: Kimi K3: Think Further. Build Bigger. Keep Going. Kimi K3 is an open 2.8T-parameter model built on our Kimi Delta Attention and Attention Residuals, with native vision and a 1M-token context window, designed for long-horizon coding, knowledge work, and reasoning.
